queries.name: identity
queries.sql: SELECT current_database() AS database,current_setting('transaction_read_only') AS read_only,now() AS snapshot_time,max(id) AS cutoff_event_id FROM event_logs

queries.name: check_payload_shape_counts
queries.sql: SELECT dagster_event_type,event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,__class__}' AS payload_class,count(*) AS count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE event::jsonb#>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,asset_key,path}' IS NULL) AS missing_asset_path FROM event_logs WHERE id<=%s AND dagster_event_type=ANY(%s) GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

queries.name: exact_owned_check_events
queries.sql: SELECT id,run_id,dagster_event_type,asset_key AS indexed_asset_key,event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,asset_key,path}' AS owner_asset_key,event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,check_name}' AS check_name,event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,target_materialization_data,storage_id}' AS target_materialization_id,octet_length(event) AS event_bytes FROM event_logs WHERE id<=%s AND dagster_event_type=ANY(%s) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(%s::text[]) k WHERE strpos(event,k)>0) AND event::jsonb#>>'{dagster_event,event_specific_data,asset_key,path}'=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id

queries.name: direct_owned_events
queries.sql: SELECT id,run_id,dagster_event_type,asset_key AS owner_asset_key,octet_length(event) AS event_bytes FROM event_logs WHERE id<=%s AND asset_key=ANY(%s) ORDER BY id

queries.name: other_check_index_references
queries.sql: SELECT asset_key,count(*) AS count FROM asset_check_executions WHERE NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) AND (evaluation_event_storage_id=ANY(%s::bigint[]) OR materialization_event_storage_id=ANY(%s::bigint[])) GROUP BY asset_key

queries.name: owned_tags
queries.sql: SELECT asset_key,count(*) AS count,count(*) FILTER (WHERE event_id=ANY(%s::bigint[])) AS linked_to_candidate_events FROM asset_event_tags WHERE asset_key=ANY(%s) GROUP BY asset_key ORDER BY asset_key

queries.name: foreign_tags_linked_to_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT asset_key,count(*) AS count FROM asset_event_tags WHERE event_id=ANY(%s::bigint[]) AND NOT(asset_key=ANY(%s)) GROUP BY asset_key

queries.name: indexed_input_pointer_references
queries.sql: SELECT asset_key,key,value,count(*) AS count FROM asset_event_tags WHERE key=ANY(%s) GROUP BY asset_key,key,value ORDER BY asset_key,key,value
